description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the /root/.openclaw/ directory structure. 2. For the version rotation (PROPRIETARY TRAP): the agent must execute the backup in strict order — first `cp maker.md.1 maker.md.2`, THEN `cp maker.md maker.md.1`, then write new content to maker.md. Reversing this order destroys history. 3. The development log must be named exactly `YYYY-MM-DD-HH-mm-开发日志-渲染管线Phase1.md` (or similar) with Chinese characters, placed in `/root/.openclaw/projects/phoenix-engine/logs/`. 4. The shared knowledge base entry must be appended to `/root/.openclaw/knowledge/decisions/decisions.md` (not inside the project folder), demonstrating understanding of the cross-project shared layer. 5. The handoff file must be named `2026-03-10-Phase1-交接.md` (with Chinese 交接) in `/root/.openclaw/projects/phoenix-engine/handoffs/`. 6. `latest.md` in handoffs MUST be a symbolic symlink (`ln -s`), not a file copy — this is explicitly called out in the SKILL.md directory structure as '符号链接' (symlink).
